label: opencode.json names no skill path at all: its only keys are $schema, permission, one mcp.code_mode entry and experimental.
.opencode/skills is a symlink to Code_Environment/Public holding 17 shared skills, none of the 16 project skills.
.claude/skills is a symlink to the same Public tree, so Claude Code never loads the 16 either.
The only load path is Commands/agent-router.md, which reads {skill_folder}/SKILL.md completely and names no sibling file.
No loader reads a file beside SKILL.md on its own, so a sibling ROUTER.md stays invisible until SKILL.md links it.
Claude Project files have no automated path: the sync compiler was retired on 2026-09-18 and files are hand-written with no manifest, lock or checksum.
Four hand-written kernels already carry a SMART ROUTING section: Sales 41, Prompt Improver 37, Barter Deal Templates 126, Sales HubSpot 107.

label: The Sales differential gate slices ## 2. SMART ROUTING out of SKILL.md by literal heading and raises ValueError if it moves.

Both differential gates already hold the pseudocode fence in a sibling references/router-contract.md, which is the precedent for the move; the Barter gate admits its prose guards still read SKILL.md tables.
Product Owner check_hub.py lists ROUTER.md in PACKET_RESIDUE and requires each packet to route in its own SKILL.md section 2, the opposite of the canon.
check_leaf_map_parity.py spans both homes: it reads the hub ROUTER.md Python block and each packet SKILL.md RESOURCE_MAP.
Four Moneybird gates treat ROUTER.md as a first-class surface: check-skill-words counts it, check-route-table regenerates its block, route-replay replays it, exit-code-parity reads its keywords.

The vendored router-shape tooling roots at .skilled/skills (ci-router-vocabulary-reach.cjs:50, generate-router-intent-signals.cjs:30) with 4 known-debt entries, so it does not police the 16 project skills.

The vendored package_skill.py swaps the RS code meanings against this repository copy: RS-004 is the packet/missing-router rule there and RS-005 the missing MACHINE ROUTER, while here RS-004 is the missing sibling router and RS-005 the pointer rule.
